description:
Accounting and tax software

ACA 1095 Reporting MultiClient version is 1094/1095 reporting and e-filing software that can be used to file multiple FEINs. It is designed for self-insured and other businesses that must file forms 1095-C or 1095-B for health care coverage for their employees and accompanying transmittals (1094-C or 1094-B). This is a multi client, site license version.
